feed.title: NPR Programs: Morning Edition
feed.subtitle: Morning Edition takes listeners around the country and the world with multi-faceted stories and commentaries every weekday. Hosts Steve Inskeep, Leila Fadel, Michel Martin and A Martínez bring you the latest breaking news and features to prepare you for the day.

entry.title: Trump makes Russia-friendly moves as he looks for a way to end the war with Ukraine
entry.summary: President Trump's up and down relationship with Russia is back on as he presses to find an end to the war in Ukraine amid high energy costs ahead of the U.S. midterms.

entry.title: Former U.S. ambassador on Trump's recent moves to embrace Russia
entry.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep speaks with former U.S. Ambassador to Russia Michael McFaul about President Trump's latest embrace of Russia and what it means for Ukraine and any hopes of peace.

entry.title: Ukrainian and Sudanese TPS recipients facing deportation get temporary reprieve
entry.summary: The Department of Homeland Security says more than 100,000 people from Ukraine and several thousand from Sudan can stay in the U.S. — for now — without immediate risk of deportation.

entry.title: Morning news brief
entry.summary: Trump presses to find an end to the war in Ukraine while courting Russia, campaigning reaches fever pitch with Election Day two weeks away, DOJ charges 28 people in California with voting crimes.

entry.title: B.J. Novak talks about his new book, 'The Little Book With No Pictures'
entry.summary: NPR's Michel Martin speaks with actor and author B.J. Novak about his new book for babies and toddlers, "The Little Book With No Pictures."

entry.title: Data center divides North Carolina county
entry.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep visits the site of a future data center in Stokes County, North Carolina.

entry.title: What to know as NBA season tips off
entry.summary: NPR's A Martinez speaks with NBC Sports' lead NBA writer Kurt Helin to preview the 2026-27 NBA season.

entry.title: 'There's a lot to be done': North Carolina continues recovery from Hurricane Helene
entry.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep visits communities still recovering from Hurricane Helene two years later.

entry.title: With just two weeks until Election Day, midterm campaigning reaches a fever pitch
entry.summary: President Trump is barnstorming the country in the last two weeks before Election Day, attempting to shift the tides of a potential midterm blue wave.

entry.title: What's the strategy behind Trump's midterm campaign tour through red states
entry.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep speaks with Kyle Kondik, managing editor of Sabato's Crystal Ball, about the strategy behind President Trump's heavy midterm travel schedule through red states.
